rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive integration with Flux Cloud and FluxOS node APIs, enabling management of decentralized applications on the Flux network. Offers tools for app lifecycle management (start/stop/restart/redeploy), observability (logs, stats, monitoring), file system operations, and the complete app registration/update workflow including spec generation, validation, pricing calculation, and cryptographic signing. Features dedicated authentication helpers for ZelID, endpoint discovery from a bundled API inventory, and safety mechanisms requiring explicit confirmation for mutating operations.
